H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H4726: properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny)
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H2403: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H5079: properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H3772: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5012: to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H517: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H1856: to stab; by analogy, to starve; figuratively, to revile
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H3847: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
H155: something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress)
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H3584: to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe)
H5647: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H7069: to erect, i.e. create; by extension, to procure, especially by purchase (causatively, sell); by implication to own
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H4347: a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence
H996: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5221: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H2719: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1397: properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply
H5997: companionship; hence (concretely) a comrade or kindred man
H7462: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
H6327: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse)
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1478: to breathe out, i.e. (by implication) expire
H7992: third; feminine athird (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell)
H3498: to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H6884: to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively)
H3701: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
H974: to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
